channel.title: Hartford Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: 🔒 Business group pushes back on bill requiring pay ranges in job postings
item.description: Employers would be required to disclose salary ranges and a general description of benefits in job postings under legislation being considered by the General Assembly.

item.title: Yale New Haven Health names new CFO
item.description: Yale New Haven Health System has chosen a Yale School of Medicine executive as its next chief financial officer.

item.title: 🔒 BioXcel Therapeutics raises $8M in stock offering
item.description: New Haven-based BioXcel Therapeutics Inc. said it has completed a stock offering that raised about $8 million from an institutional investor.

item.title: 🔒 Cheshire approves office building near The Shops at Stone Bridge
item.description: A proposal to build a one-story office building for three tenants in Cheshire was unanimously approved this week by the town Planning & Zoning Commission.

item.title: 🔒 CT bill would allow small businesses to pool workers to save on health insurance, proposes study of ‘Connecticut Option’
item.description: State lawmakers are considering legislation that would allow small businesses to pool their workers to provide more affordable health insurance, while also requiring a study of a possible state-designed health plan known as the “Connecticut Option.”

item.title: 🔒 CT’s billionaire class grows to 19 on Forbes 2026 list; 8 crack top 1,000
item.description: Hedge fund magnate Steve Cohen is once again the wealthiest person in Connecticut, topping a list of 19 state residents named to the Forbes 2026 World’s Billionaires ranking released Wednesday.

item.title: Proposed DECD concierge program modeled after DEEP initiative
item.description: A bill before the General Assembly would require the state Department of Economic and Community Development to establish a concierge service for small businesses, borrowing from a model already in use at the state’s environmental agency.

item.title: East Hartford’s HORST hiring for major aerospace ramp-up
item.description: East Hartford-based HORST Engineering says it is hiring as it ramps up production of machined components and assemblies for aerospace customers.

item.title: Blumenthal, Murphy endorse Lamont’s bid for third term
item.description: Connecticut’s two U.S. senators have endorsed Gov. Ned Lamont’s bid for re-election, citing his record on economic policy, social programs and cooperation with the state’s congressional delegation.

item.title: A new ‘vision’: Hartford corporate leaders push for more residents, activity downtown
item.description: A comprehensive report expected in early June will outline recommendations intended to guide public and private investment and shape Hartford’s next phase of development.
